summary.en: The camera flies low over a product page in three legs, almost edge-on; the page's words hover with soft shadows and land as the camera passes them.
summary.zh: 相机分三段贴着产品页面低飞，几乎与页面平行；页面上的字带着软阴影悬浮，镜头经过时依次落下。

fits: A hook or a demo that shows the product's interface as a place, without reading it (demo, hook).
notFor: Interfaces that must be read (the page is seen at a grazing angle); a single feature; light films that should stay flat.

intent.en: The interface as a landscape: the camera skims its surface and the page completes itself as it passes, so the viewer feels inside the product's world.
intent.zh: 把界面拍成地形：镜头贴着表面掠过，页面在镜头经过时自己完成，观众像身在产品的内里世界。

content.en: Product name, a section name, 6–10 tree items and 3–5 tabs (≤ 14 chars, Chinese ≤ 5 characters), a title and subtitle, 4–6 list rows; none of it is read closely.
content.zh: 产品名、分区名、6–10 个侧栏条目和 3–5 个标签（≤ 14 字符、中文 ≤ 5 字），一个标题和副标题，4–6 行列表；都不需要细读。

fits.zh: 把产品界面当一个地方来展示、不要求读清的开场或演示。

notFor.zh: 必须读清的界面（掠射角下看不清）；单个功能；要保持平面的明亮片子。

en: Lift the hovering words (~1.3× brightness) so they are not swallowed by the dark; without visible hover the landing is lost.
Not in the same section as perspective-glide: there the page moves, here the camera does.
zh: 悬空的字要提亮约 1.3 倍，别被暗部吞掉；看不出悬浮，落定就白做了。
别和 perspective-glide 同段：那个页面动，这个镜头动。

upstream.name: 贴面游走
upstream.summary: 大倾角贴面游走特写——镜头贴着 UI 表面低飞掠过（侧栏树/顶栏/列表当地形），页面文字初始悬浮在界面上空带同形软影，随镜头行进先后加速贴落回界面
upstream.use: 功能区巡礼（把 UI 当地景飞掠）；配合暗场+霓虹缘光做产品"内里世界"段落；界面内容逐区登场
upstream.energy: 中高（运镜持续推进+元素连续落位，信息密度高）

overlaps.note: float-land is the landing of hovering pieces on one surface; graze-tour flies three camera legs over three pages and lands their words as it passes
perspective-glide slides one tilted page past the camera; graze-tour flies almost edge-on and lands the page's words

waive.all: no element of the upstream page pairs with the brick's: the three pages are laid out anew from the slots (a tree, a top bar, a list) and the words are the film's; the camera legs, the cruise curve and the cross-fades are the upstream's numbers, and the landing is float-land's, whose compare passes
